name: foam-rolling-hip-flexor
instructions:
1. In a prone position, place the foam roller directly below the crease of your hip and slightly above your thigh. It should rest comfortably at the base of the hip joint on the front side of the leg.
2. Support your upper body using your forearms. Position your other leg to the side at a 90 degree angle and allow the knee to rest on the ground.
3. Adjust pressure into the roller by applying more or less force through the forearms and knee.
4. Slowly roll up and down the length of the hip flexor for 20-30 seconds.
5. Repeat on the other side.
